All four of reviewer 1's blockers are therefore dropped as context errors from a reviewer that never saw the tree or the full spec (its own process note says the successful pass ran on condensed descriptions). That is a should-fix, not a blocker, because task 7's op-table-parity and prompt-structure suites remain the primary gate; the verify line should still be tightened before execution.

dropped: Reviewer 1 #1 (task 3 depends same-wave on task 26's finish-step contract): not confirmed. The finish-step deploy contract and the full flag list task 3 forwards (--deploy-authorize … --archive-pushed, --sha) are established by task 23 in wave 1 (its integration note enumerates every flag); tasks 24/25 extend it in waves 2–3. Task 26 (wave 4) completes the replay test suite and shares no files with task 3. Residual caveat, not promoted: task 3's 'one gate-routing case per finish flag' touches intent_confirm/archive gates that tasks 27–29 finish in waves 5–7, but task 6 (wave 6) and the wave-9/10 knob-contract suites re-exercise the CLI-to-finish surface afterward.

Reviewer 1 #2 (task 6 in wave 6 asserts push_archive/pushed:no and required_successor before tasks 28/29 produce them): not confirmed. `pushed: no` and the required_successor obligation line are CLI projections over events whose append-time schemas land in task 1 (wave 0) and whose obligation projection lands in task 33 (wave 0); task 3 already implements both projections in wave 4. Task 6's fixtures write the same schema-validated events the later finish-step writers emit, so a divergence would fail append-time validation rather than pass silently; task 48 (wave 6) additionally re-runs the doctor checks against writer-produced bundles.

Reviewer 1 #3 (tasks 18 and 21 both edit test/config.test.mjs in wave 2): false. plan.index.json task 21's files are lib/paths.mjs, lib/dispatch/routing-policy.mjs, lib/dispatch-wave.mjs, lib/doctor/routing-policy-health.mjs, lib/doctor/codex-auth.mjs, lib/doctor/pi-agent-registration.mjs, bin/doctor.mjs, test/paths.test.mjs, test/routing-policy.test.mjs, test/dispatch-wave.test.mjs, test/doctor.test.mjs, lib/config.mjs — no test/config.test.mjs. A script over every wave reports zero same-wave file collisions.

Reviewer 1 #4 (task 42's wave-0 bump to 10.0.0 is premature and no task runs the real release script live): contradicts the spec by design. Spec §3 and §7.1 make the version bump ordinary run-branch work checked by `version_not_bumped` before the branch retires, and §11 `publish-hygiene` requires '10.0.0 everywhere' on the branch; the bump is on the run branch, not main (tree still shows 9.10.0 on main). Spec §10.1 step 1 and A33 state the live bootstrap stage (including `scripts/release.mjs --version=10.0.0`) is 'not a plan wave … never a task', and plan.index.json meta.solution records the stage as the post-wave operator-gated procedure with its finish preconditions. Adding it as a plan task would violate the spec.
